purpose: Dev-only anatomy and paired ownership diagnostic; no predictor, policy optimization or alpha claim
reserved_and_sealed_days: Forbidden; basket_sim.guard_day applies before data access
state_time: Panel et is a bar-start label; its completed state is available at decision_et=et+1. No state uses any later bar or any member/session outcome.
voluntary_decisions: After actual entry; et < session_end-1. Forced-flat precedence unchanged. Preserve and count ineligible/missing-next-open states.
immediate_liquidation: Panel next_open/next_et must match the subsequent observed bar_open/et for that member. No same-bar execution, no invented bar across a gap, no last-print endpoint.
existing_entry_cost: Sunk; excluded from current-dollar outcomes. Entry price remains allowed only as past state and separately labelled retrospective tail attribution.
baseline: W_exit=q*P_exit*(1-0.005), where P_exit is the next executable open after the completed decision; q=1 is sufficient by linear scaling.
continuation: For every later observed executable minute endpoint e up to forced flat: W_hold=q*P_open(e)*(1-0.005); CV=W_hold/W_exit-1. The immediate-liquidation endpoint itself has CV=0.
horizons: Report elapsed ET minutes from decision_et and from immediate_exit_et separately. Every available integer-minute endpoint, not a selected optimal horizon. Gaps remain missing on the elapsed-time lattice; terminal is one secondary endpoint.
fresh_admission: Not evaluated in this diagnostic. Do not subtract a second round-trip fee from an already-owned hold-versus-liquidate comparison.
giveback_anchor: First causal giveback:10 event under basket_atlas_ledger.Giveback.locate_exit/giveback_mask semantics: scan starts at bar_index 1, forced-flat precedence at et>=session_end-1, trigger close<=running_high*0.9+1e-9*running_high. Detect from state, never future giveback_fired/v_giveback labels.
reentry_trigger: After the sale has executed, first completed bar with bar label >= actual_exit_et and close>=GROSS realized exit open P_exit. No intrabar high-touch, no requirement for a further dip, no additional tuned confirmation.
reentry_execution: Buy only at the next observed executable open after the reclaim bar. Must be strictly later than sale. No reentry decision at et>=session_end-1, and no buy at/after session_end.
reentry_quantity: q_new=W_exit/[P_reentry*(1+0.005)] using only available cash. Before reentry B holds W_exit; after reentry liquidation value is q_new*P_future*(1-0.005). A retains q shares throughout until the common executable endpoint.
comparison: Publish W_retain/W_exit and W_sell_reenter/W_exit, their difference and both branch fill timelines for every supported subsequent ET-minute endpoint. One sale and at most one reentry, not a recurring trading policy.
no_event: Retain in the overall member census; no-giveback members have identical branches. Report event-conditioned and whole-basket attribution separately; do not mix denominators.
censoring: Never filter the causal risk set on terminal_censored, future recovery, future monster status or complete-path flags. Retain observed partial-horizon outcomes, count unknown later endpoints, and never call an incomplete unrecovered path a never-recovery.
states: Positive allowlist of existing causal panel coordinates only: family, decision clock, tenure, ret_from_fill, mfe_so_far, dist_from_running_high, mfe_surrendered, bars_since_new_high, reclaim_count, failed_reclaim_count, ret_1/ret_3/ret_5, up_close_streak, volume_vs_own_median, volume_accel, ret_percentile_candidates, peer_ret_median, peer_new_high_5. Missing stays unknown.
atlas_features: Excluded from this first diagnostic. EV01 geometry/neighbours are retrospective and not historical-only.
analysis: Descriptive curves only: family/clock/tenure baseline plus one causal coordinate at a time in coarse declared bins. No joint high-dimensional state grid, no ML, no horizon/stop/size optimization.
aggregation: Publish occupancy-weighted and equal-member-within-day/family weighted views separately; block/month tables; day/month-clustered uncertainty on descriptive means. Minute snapshots and three scales are not independent units.
tail: Keep all observed extremes untrimmed. Report quantiles, positive/negative dollar contributions, top contributors, concentration, and labelled future-giant/recoverer/failure attribution. Future labels are NEVER states, selection rules or claimed executable peak values.
shared_outputs: data/atlas/continuation/cv01/base/{states.parquet,executions.parquet,members.parquet}; evidence only under factory/artifacts/basket/phase2/ATLAS/CV01/. No materialized full member-minute-horizon Cartesian table.
scope: Experiments A and B only. Do not fit Test C, use reserved months, evaluate outsiders, size capital, or start sub-minute work. Conclusions apply only to the measured primitive.
